conclusion: Ancient humans did interbreed with other hominins: population-genomic and ancient-DNA evidence supports Neanderthal-related and Denisovan-related gene flow into modern-human-related populations, while Denisova 11 provides direct evidence of Neanderthal-Denisovan first-generation parentage. Inference of exact donor, direction, timing, pulse count, and functional consequence remains model- and sample-dependent.
known_risks: The report is an evidence synthesis and research design, not a new ancient-genome analysis.
Source identity, timing, direction, and pulse count remain conditional on sparse ancient sampling, reference panels, recombination maps, and demographic-model assumptions.
The final PDF contains documented nonblocking MiKTeX logging and LaTeX float-balancing warnings; visual inspection found no clipping.
